description: This PHP source file defines a class `ViewShowDuplicates` which extends `SugarView` to handle displaying duplicate Leads in the SuiteCRM application. It manages data retrieval, prepares the display form, and includes logic specific to the Leads module, particularly for handling and displaying potential duplicate records during lead creation.

classes.name: ViewShowDuplicates
classes.description: A subclass of SugarView that handles rendering the duplicate leads list and associated form in the Leads module for SuiteCRM.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Main method to prepare and render the duplicate leads view, including data retrieval, form preparation, and template rendering.
